story.so_that: an engineer can safely improve an existing skill through evaluation-driven refinement, and the workflow is usable as an exposed capability rather than only as a collection of internal Activities
story.i_want: to start the EDD refinement workflow from one portable input document, have every operation run against the intended target repository, and receive durable progress and terminal evidence

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a valid EDD input document and an existing clean skill repository, when the requester invokes scripts/kickoff-edd-refinement.sh, then the CLI starts EddRefinementWorkflow and prints its workflow and run IDs
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a valid EDD input document and an existing clean skill repository When the requester invokes scripts/kickoff-edd-refinement.sh Then the CLI starts EddRefinementWorkflow and prints its workflow and run IDs

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given skill_folder is relative to the input document, when preflight resolves it, then the nearest containing Git worktree becomes the immutable target root and every scoped path is validated against it
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given skill_folder is relative to the input document When preflight resolves it Then the nearest containing Git worktree becomes the immutable target root and every scoped path is validated against it

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given any input path resolves outside the target worktree through traversal or symlink resolution, when preflight validates the request, then the workflow rejects it before invoking an agent or evaluation command
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given any input path resolves outside the target worktree through traversal or symlink resolution When preflight validates the request Then the workflow rejects it before invoking an agent or evaluation command

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given eval_config resolves exactly one provider, when baseline and candidate evaluations run, then both use that provider and the progress record captures its non-secret identity; given the configuration resolves zero or multiple providers, then preflight rejects the request
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given eval_config resolves exactly one provider When baseline and candidate evaluations run Then both use that provider and the progress record captures its non-secret identity Given the configuration resolves zero or multiple providers Then preflight rejects the request

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given an evaluation command completes and returns an evaluation identity, when result inspection runs, then inspect_command receives that identity and the workflow does not infer the most recent evaluation
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given an evaluation command completes and returns an evaluation identity When result inspection runs Then inspect_command receives that identity and the workflow does not infer the most recent evaluation

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given inspector results contain IDs at the configured coverage_metadata_property, when metrics are extracted, then covered and uncovered required test-case IDs are calculated from enabled evaluations and unknown IDs invalidate the evidence
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given inspector results contain IDs at the configured coverage_metadata_property When metrics are extracted Then covered and uncovered required test-case IDs are calculated from enabled evaluations and unknown IDs invalidate the evidence

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given an evaluation exceeds limits.eval_timeout_seconds, when Cadence times out the Activity, then the attempt is recorded, retry policy is applied, and no duplicate logical iteration is created
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given an evaluation exceeds limits.eval_timeout_seconds When Cadence times out the Activity Then the attempt is recorded, retry policy is applied, and no duplicate logical iteration is created

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given preflight succeeds, when the workflow waits, retries, or advances through multiple iterations, then its repository lease remains valid until finalization and blocks another mutating run against the same target
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given preflight succeeds When the workflow waits, retries, or advances through multiple iterations Then its repository lease remains valid until finalization and blocks another mutating run against the same target

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the first candidate is accepted and limits permit more work, when its commit and state update complete, then the workflow schedules another planning cycle rather than returning after one attempt
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the first candidate is accepted and limits permit more work When its commit and state update complete Then the workflow schedules another planning cycle rather than returning after one attempt

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a worker restarts after candidate execution but before comparison, when Cadence replays the workflow, then it resumes evaluation or comparison for the same candidate without rerunning the agent action
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a worker restarts after candidate execution but before comparison When Cadence replays the workflow Then it resumes evaluation or comparison for the same candidate without rerunning the agent action

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the EDD module is present in the workflow catalog, when the workflow engine starts, then catalog inspection includes the EDD topology and a worker polls the edd-refinement task list
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the EDD module is present in the workflow catalog When the workflow engine starts Then catalog inspection includes the EDD topology and a worker polls the edd-refinement task list

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a candidate qualifies for acceptance, when the workflow commits it, then the commit follows the target repository's applicable rules and the git-commit skill conventions without requiring identity fields in the input
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a candidate qualifies for acceptance When the workflow commits it Then the commit follows the target repository's applicable rules and the git-commit skill conventions without requiring identity fields in the input

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given an input document at <parent>/edd-input.json, when the run initializes, then its progress record is published under <parent>/.process/edd/<run-id>/ without allowing that run-owned path to hide unrelated changes
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given an input document at <parent>/edd-input.json When the run initializes Then its progress record is published under <parent>/.process/edd/<run-id>/ without allowing that run-owned path to hide unrelated changes

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given any successful, rejected, timed-out, failed, or human-handoff terminal outcome, when the workflow terminates, then it publishes a terminal record, leaves the target at the best accepted state, and releases or reports failure to release the lease
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given any successful, rejected, timed-out, failed, or human-handoff terminal outcome When the workflow terminates Then it publishes a terminal record, leaves the target at the best accepted state, and releases or reports failure to release the lease

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the orchestration repository and target skill repository are different local Git worktrees, when an end-to-end EDD run is executed, then all skill, evaluation, inspection, artifact, and Git operations use the intended target and input locations, and the orchestration worktree remains unchanged
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the orchestration repository and target skill repository are different local Git worktrees When an end-to-end EDD run is executed Then all skill, evaluation, inspection, artifact, and Git operations use the intended target and input locations, and the orchestration worktree remains unchanged

edge_cases.criterion: An EDD input document is missing a required field or contains malformed JSON
edge_cases.gherkin: Given an EDD input document is missing a required field or contains malformed JSON When preflight validates the request Then the workflow rejects it before any agent or evaluation is invoked

edge_cases.criterion: A required input path resolves outside the target worktree through traversal or symlink resolution
edge_cases.gherkin: Given a required input path resolves outside the target worktree through traversal or symlink resolution When preflight validates the request Then the workflow rejects the request before invoking an agent or evaluation command

edge_cases.criterion: The target worktree is dirty before run-owned artifacts are created
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the target worktree is dirty before run-owned artifacts are created When preflight runs Then the workflow rejects the request before acquiring a mutation lease

edge_cases.criterion: The evaluation configuration resolves zero or multiple execution providers
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the evaluation configuration resolves zero or multiple execution providers When preflight inspects the eval_config Then the workflow rejects the request

edge_cases.criterion: A required test case references an unknown ID in the evaluation metadata
edge_cases.gherkin: Given a required test case references an unknown ID in the evaluation metadata When metrics are extracted Then the candidate evidence is invalidated

edge_cases.criterion: A candidate evaluation exceeds the configured eval_timeout_seconds
edge_cases.gherkin: Given a candidate evaluation exceeds the configured eval_timeout_seconds When Cadence times out the Activity Then the attempt is recorded, retry policy applies, and no duplicate logical iteration is created

edge_cases.criterion: Another mutating EDD run is already holding a lease on the same target repository
edge_cases.gherkin: Given another mutating EDD run is already holding a lease on the same target repository When preflight attempts to acquire a lease Then the workflow rejects the new run

edge_cases.criterion: A worker restarts after a candidate is executed but before comparison is complete
edge_cases.gherkin: Given a worker restarts after a candidate is executed but before comparison is complete When Cadence replays the workflow Then it resumes evaluation or comparison for the same candidate without rerunning the agent action

edge_cases.criterion: A candidate appears degraded on the first comparison and is rerun unchanged
edge_cases.gherkin: Given a candidate appears degraded on the first comparison and is rerun unchanged When the repeated comparison is also degraded Then the workflow classifies it as a confirmed regression and reverts the accepted state

edge_cases.criterion: A human approval proposal expires before a decision is received
edge_cases.gherkin: Given a human approval proposal expires before a decision is received When the approval timeout elapses Then the workflow treats the absence as no approval and does not apply the expectation-changing action

edge_cases.criterion: The run reaches the configured max_iterations or max_tokens after an accepted candidate
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the run reaches the configured max_iterations or max_tokens after an accepted candidate When the limit check runs Then the workflow finalizes with the best accepted state and does not schedule another planning cycle

edge_cases.criterion: The mutation lease cannot be released at terminal finalization
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the mutation lease cannot be released at terminal finalization When the workflow terminates Then the terminal record reports the release failure and the best accepted state is still published

ui: Approval proposal display and decision forwarding
database: Progress record and terminal record store
Durable counters for iteration, token usage, attempts, and regressions
external_services: Target repository Git worktree and commit operations

steps.description: Implement and version the EddRefinementInput schema, JSON validation, and path resolution relative to the input document parent
Implement the kickoff shell script and edd-refinement-cli start/query/approve/reject subcommands with absolute-path handling and durable ID reporting

Implement target repository preflight: resolve the Git worktree from skill_folder, canonicalize scoped paths, validate containment, check worktree cleanliness, and discover exactly one evaluation provider
Implement the repository-scoped MutationLeaseStore with acquire, release, TTL, and re-entrant same-run semantics
Implement the schema-versioned ProgressRecord and TerminalReport data models with allow-list redaction before persistence
Implement InitializeRunActivity to create or resume a progress record under <input-parent>/.process/edd/<run-id>/ and derive a stable run id
Implement RunBaselineEvaluationActivity: execute test_command, capture evaluation_id, parse structured pass/fail/coverage metrics, and record baseline evidence
Implement the evaluation identity chain: parse evaluation_id from test_command output and interpolate it into inspect_command argv
Implement required test-case coverage calculation using coverage_metadata_property and invalidate evidence that contains unknown test-case IDs
Implement PlanRefinementActivity to select an authorized action, a stop decision, or an approval-required expectation change, constrained by budget and regression threshold
Implement approval proposal generation and signal handling with stable proposal_id, diff_hash, deadline, and recorded decision history
Implement candidate execution through the Devin harness with a colocated accept-edits configuration, returning changed files, diff hash, and token usage
Implement candidate validation, scope and diff checks, and persistence so replay can reuse already-executed candidates
Implement candidate evaluation and quality-ratchet comparison: accept gains, rerun degraded, confirm regressions, and escalate inconclusive evidence
Implement commit_accepted_candidate using the target repository's git-commit skill conventions and Git config identity
Implement rerun_degraded_candidate and regression recovery: revert to the best accepted revision, run verification evaluation, and update durable regression counters
Implement durable limit checks for max_iterations, max_tokens, eval_timeout_seconds, and the regression stop threshold
Implement finalize_run: publish the terminal record, restore or confirm the target repository at the best accepted state, and release or report the mutation lease on every terminal path
Register the EDD refinement workflow module in the orchestrator catalog and configure a worker that polls the edd-refinement task list
Wire the EddRefinementWorkflow as a multi-iteration loop with deterministic Activities, Cadence replay resumption, and Continue-As-New readiness

unit_tests.description: EddRefinementInput schema validation rejects missing or malformed fields and resolves relative paths from the input parent
TargetWorktreeResolver and ScopedPathValidator reject traversal, symlink escapes, and paths outside the target worktree
SkillAndEvaluationDiscovery rejects zero or multiple providers and returns the single selected provider
MutationLeaseStore enforces uniqueness by repo_key and run_id, respects TTL, and handles re-entrant same-run requests
ProgressRecordSerializer redacts credential-bearing fields and enforces schema version on read and write
Evaluation identity parsing and inspect_command placeholder replacement produce the exact command argv
Coverage calculator marks required test cases as covered or uncovered and invalidates evidence with unknown IDs
Quality-ratchet decisions classify accept, reject, rerun, regression, and human_handoff correctly
Approval signal handler matches proposal_id and diff_hash, enforces deadline, and ignores late or mismatched signals
git-commit skill loader falls back to a default conventional commit when the target repository has no skill

integration_tests.description: CLI start invokes the workflow, returns workflow_id and run_id, and query returns durable status
Preflight sequence resolves the target, validates paths, discovers the provider, and acquires a mutation lease
InitializeRun creates and resumes a progress record under the input-parent .process directory
Baseline and candidate evaluation Activities capture evaluation_id and produce deterministic structured metrics
Multi-iteration workflow loops through planning, execution, validation, and evaluation until a limit or stop condition
Cadence worker restart and replay resume from the persisted progress record without re-executing the harness
Regression recovery reverts to the best accepted state and publishes a redacted reverted-proposal record
Finalization publishes a terminal record, leaves the target at the best accepted state, and releases the lease

e2e_tests.description: A full EDD run against an external target skill repository accepts a candidate, commits it, and produces a terminal record
An approval-required evaluation-expectation change can be approved and applied, or rejected and skipped, with a durable decision record
A regression is confirmed, reverted, and recovered without corrupting the target repository or iteration state
The orchestration worktree remains unchanged while the target worktree receives only authorized modifications

risks_and_mitigations.risk: A path-traversal or symlink attack could make a scoped input resolve outside the target worktree
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Canonicalize with Path.resolve(), enforce containment with Path.relative_to(), and reject any escape before preflight completes

risks_and_mitigations.risk: A crash after lease acquisition leaves the repository locked indefinitely
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Use a short TTL, acquire the lease only after all other preflight checks pass, and release or report it on every terminal path

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Concurrent EDD runs targeting the same repository race and corrupt each other's changes
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Enforce immediate-reject lease policy keyed by canonical repo_key and run_id

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Cadence worker restart or replay reruns non-deterministic Activities and corrupts the progress record
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Make all Activities deterministic and idempotent, persist candidate results, and validate schema version on every read

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Evaluation timeout or non-deterministic provider produces stale or duplicate iteration data
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Pin exactly one provider, apply the configured eval_timeout_seconds with a retry policy, and record attempts without creating duplicate logical iterations

risks_and_mitigations.risk: A dirty target worktree or run-owned scratch directory hides unrelated changes
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Reject unexpected changes in preflight, write durable artifacts outside the target worktree, and confine any in-target scratch to configured globs

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Secrets or credentials leak into the progress or terminal record
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Maintain an explicit allow-list of record fields and redact environment variables, API keys, and credential-bearing paths before every write

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Accepted candidates are committed with the wrong author, sign-off, or message format
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Load the target repository's git-commit skill and read author/committer from the target's Git config, falling back to a default conventional commit
